result.title: Benchmarking System One Models for Time-Series Decision Making: A Case Study of Jev
result.summary: Time-series tasks require both accurate predictions and fast decisions. Advances in large models have introduced decision-oriented models that directly output answers and their probabilities, which we call Structured System 1 models. Their applicability to time-series tasks remains underexplored. Using Jev 1.13.0 as a case study, we evaluate time-series classification, event type prediction, oil temperature direction and stock movement prediction, converting continuous forecasting targets into discrete decisions to fit the model interface. We establish a unified evaluation framework using accuracy and AUC. Results show stronger performance on selected explicit temporal patterns and event type prediction, but near-chance discrimination on many numerical sequence classification tasks and stock movement prediction. Some datasets also reveal a gap between ranking quality and final decision accuracy. These findings motivate improvements in temporal representation, domain adaptation, and decision-score alignment. Standardized sample construction, model calls, and result recording support extending the evaluation to future models.

AI.brief_summary: 以 Jev 1.13.0 为例，把时间序列分类、事件类型与涨跌方向等任务转成离散决策，用统一框架评估直接输出答案及概率的「结构化 System 1」模型，并报告准确率与 AUC。
AI.relevance_reason: 单次前向直接给出答案与决策分数的设定，可能为 LVR 中「是否思考、何时停止」提供无 latent 推理的对照，以及决策分数对齐与排序-准确率脱节的观察线索；但任务为纯时间序列、无视觉证据与内部状态，迁移价值待核查。
